title: Unexpected Teleportation
next_chapter_hook: The moment Chen Ji stepped into the cell, the formation runes on the walls suddenly lit up—his position had long been tracked.

text.content: As the ancient teleportation array's light faded, Chen Ji felt the ground solidify beneath his feet, a cold and damp breath rushing toward him. He opened his eyes to find a dark stone chamber, its dome inlaid with several eerie green phosphorescent lights, making the surroundings appear like a realm of ghosts. The air was thick with the heavy smell of blood and rotting mildew, nearly causing him to retch. "Here..." Ye Qing's voice came from behind, also carrying a suppressed gasp of astonishment.

Chen Ji forcefully suppressed the churning discomfort and surveyed his surroundings. The stone walls were covered with obscure runes, faintly emitting a heart-stopping spiritual fluctuation—this was a sealing formation pattern, and an extremely ancient one at that. Beneath his feet lay a massive circular formation disc, bearing a striking resemblance to the teleportation array they had just activated, though with dozens of additional branches extending outward from its edges like a spider's web. "A secret stronghold of the Holy Sect," Ye Qing's voice turned cold. "We've been brought here."

Chen Ji didn't answer. All his attention was captured by another sensation—a familiar scent that made his heart stop, emanating from the depths of the stone chamber. It was... Chen Nian's aura. Three years had passed. He had searched the entire world, believing his sister was no longer among the living. But now, that blood-bonded sensation was so clear, so real, pulling him toward a certain direction. "Chen Ji?" Ye Qing frowned at his suddenly pallid face. "What's wrong?"

dialogue.content: "She's here." Chen Ji's voice was hoarse, unlike his own. "Chen Nian is here."

text.content: Ye Qing's pupils contracted slightly. As a Holy Sect Demon Path Saint, she had naturally heard of Chen Nian's name—the Heavenly Fate Lock Key, the Chen family orphan, a key criminal the Holy Sect had pursued for years. But she never expected this girl, rumored to have perished long ago, to actually still be alive, let alone hidden in such a remote location. "Are you certain?" she asked gravely. "This could be a trap." Chen Ji closed his eyes. The Tianji Record in his mind slightly warmed, and the blurry images finally found their direction—March seventh, just ahead.

dialogue.content: "Whether it's a trap or not," Ye Qing's eyes flickered, "I just sensed that the guard force in this stronghold isn't strong. Most personnel seem to have been deployed elsewhere. This is a rare opportunity." She looked at Chen Ji. "How we proceed, you decide."

choice.prompt: After sensing his sister's presence, Chen Ji needed to decide his next course of action—

choices.text: Let Ye Qing lead the infiltration
choices.description: Use Ye Qing's Demon Path mist to conceal their aura, quietly approaching the target to avoid alerting the enemy.
choices.visible_cost: Time-consuming, may be discovered by patrols
choices.visible_reward: Safely approach the target, time to observe the enemy's situation
choices.risk_hint: If detected, will fall into encirclement

text.content: Ye Qing nodded. A thin layer of black mist rose around her, shrouding them both. "Don't speak, stay close behind me." Her voice was extremely low, but her steps were steady as a cat's, each one precisely avoiding the formation rune patterns on the ground. Chen Ji followed behind her, secretly amazed—this Demon Path Saint's stealth skills were indeed well-deserved of her reputation.

choices.description: The bloodline's call made him unable to wait any longer. Even if it exposed their position, he had to confirm his sister's safety first.
choices.visible_cost: May trigger trap alarms, alert enemies

text.content: Chen Ji didn't hesitate. He rushed forward following that familiar aura. Ye Qing froze for a moment, then gritted her teeth and followed. "You're insane!" she whispered urgently, yet her hand had already formed a protective ball of demonic energy around Chen Ji. Chen Ji was deaf to her words. His eyes now held only what lay ahead—that bloodline connection was growing clearer and clearer. His sister was right there!

Passing through three dark corridors and turning two corners, Chen Ji finally saw her. Chen Nian was imprisoned in the center of a massive cell, with four stone pillars covered in runes standing around her, layer upon layer of barrier light screens enclosing her. Her hands were hung up by chains, her clothes ragged, her hair disheveled, and dried bloodstains still visible on her cheeks. Yet even so, she still lifted her head defiantly. Those eyes—her eyebrows and eyes identical to his—still caused Chen Ji's heart to ache terribly even through the barrier light screens.

dialogue.content: "...Brother Ji?" Chen Nian's voice was hoarse and weak, yet carried an unbelievable tremor. "How did you... No, run! This is a trap!"

text.content: Three years. Chen Ji looked at this emaciated girl before him, his fists clenched until his knuckles turned white. Three years ago, when she was taken, she was still a little girl who would hide behind him and act spoiled. Now, she had been tortured beyond recognition, locked in this sunless underground prison. He took a deep breath, suppressing the surging killing intent, and was about to speak when a faint vibration came from beneath his feet—coming from deeper within.

Chen Ji looked toward the source of the vibration, his pupils suddenly contracting. At the end of the cell was a massive stone door,诡异的血红色光芒从门缝中透出，伴随着low的诵经声。那声音苍老而晦涩，像是从远古传来的呢喃，每一个音节都带着令人心悸的力量。"这是……"夜清的脸色也变了，"献祭仪式？"

Chen Ji closed his eyes. The Tianji Record in his mind ran at lightning speed. The images from the fragment gradually became clear—a blood-red altar, stacked corpses, and a massive formation requiring Chen bloodline as the "primer" to activate. The prophecy of March seventh finally presented itself completely before his eyes. The Holy Sect's intention was not merely to imprison Chen Nian, but to use her blood, her life, to complete some earth-shattering conspiracy.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing crouched by the door gap. After seeing the scene inside, she drew a sharp breath. "The altar is already set up. Looking at the brightness of the formation runes... we have at most three hours." She turned to Chen Ji. "We need to do two things simultaneously—save her and disrupt the ritual. But we don't have enough people."

text.content: Chen Ji remained silent for a moment, his gaze shifting between the cell and the stone door. Chen Nian's barriers needed to be broken, and the ritual at the altar needed to be stopped—both couldn't be delayed, yet also couldn't be done simultaneously. His mind raced, calculating every possibility. Over three hundred years, he had encountered countless such desperate situations, and each time he had survived through precise calculation and decisive execution.

choice.prompt: The sacrifice ritual is about to begin. Chen Ji must make a choice—

choices.description: His sister was the driving force behind his three hundred years of穿越. Anything else could wait,唯独她的命不能拿来赌。仪式可以之后再想办法破坏。
choices.visible_cost: May not have time to stop the sacrifice
choices.visible_reward: Ensure Chen Nian's safety, even if the ritual succeeds it becomes meaningless
choices.risk_hint: If the ritual completes, the consequences will be unimaginable

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated no longer. He walked straight toward the cell. "Chen Nian, don't be afraid." His voice was low and firm. "I've come to take you home." He pressed one hand against the barrier light screen. The power of the Tianji Record surged forth instantly. The runes on the ancient fragment resonated with the barriers, causing the layers of light screens to begin cracking. Ye Qing stood guard nearby, alertly watching the surroundings, ready to strike at any moment.

choices.description: Chen Nian has been imprisoned for three years without dying, meaning the ritual still needs her as a living sacrifice. As long as the altar is destroyed, we can buy more time.
choices.visible_cost: Chen Nian may suffer barrier backlash
choices.visible_reward: Fundamentally dismantle the Holy Sect's plan
choices.risk_hint: The disturbance from breaking the formation will alert everyone

dialogue.content: When Chen Nian heard Chen Ji's plan, her face turned deathly pale: "No! The altar is heavily guarded, and the formation core... Brother Ji, you don't know how ruthless they are!" Her voice carried a sob. "Please don't risk yourself for me..."

text.content: Just then, hurried footsteps and shouting came from the distance. Chen Ji's position had, after all, been exposed. A guard came running frantically. When he saw Chen Ji and the others, his face changed dramatically. Just as he was about to raise the alarm, a black shadow flashed. The man fell silently. Ye Qing withdrew her hand, her expression calm: "Move faster. They've dispatched more people." Chen Ji nodded, but his gaze fell on the ground beneath Chen Nian's feet—the formation runes there resonated with those on the altar, faintly outlining a massive formation eye pattern.

He understood. This entire underground stronghold was itself a massive formation, and Chen Nian's location happened to be exactly at the formation's eye. No matter who he saved first or second, as long as the Holy Sect activated the final formation runes, everything would return to square one. Unless—he could simultaneously destroy both the formation eye and the altar in the same instant. A cold smile curved Chen Ji's lips. Over three hundred years, his greatest skill had been finding that sole path to survival within desperation.

dialogue.content: "Ye Qing, I need you to do one thing." Chen Ji's voice regained its usual composure. "Go to the altar and cover those formation runes with your Demon Path mist. Hold out as long as you can." Ye Qing raised an eyebrow: "And you?" Chen Ji didn't answer. He simply raised his hand. The Tianji Record slowly materialized in his palm, emanating an antique and mysterious glow. Mo Xiansheng had said—the more complete the Tianji Record, the stronger the destined fatal backlash. But sometimes, the backlash itself is the sharpest weapon.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji decided to use the Tianji Record as the core to simultaneously destroy both formation eyes, which would bring enormous backlash—

choices.description: Consume a large amount of Heavenly Fate, using the Tianji Record's power to simultaneously strike the formation eye and altar, solving both problems at once.
choices.visible_cost: Heavenly Fate will be greatly consumed, possibly triggering unknown backlash
choices.visible_reward: Simultaneously destroy both formation cores, completely dismantling the Holy Sect's plan
choices.risk_hint: The degree of backlash is unpredictable

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated no longer. He poured all his concentration into the Tianji Record. The antique fragment suddenly burst forth with dazzling golden light. A massive stream of information surged into his consciousness like a tide—this was the backlash of foresight, and also the gift of foresight. Over three hundred years, he had never "seen" the future so clearly: every crack in the formation runes, every pause in the chanting, every trace of fear in the guards' eyes—all were captured in perfect detail.

choices.description: Only destroy the formation eye, rescue Chen Nian, then retreat in the chaos without confronting the Holy Sect directly. Address the altar's threat another day.
choices.visible_cost: The altar remains, the Holy Sect may still complete the ritual
choices.visible_reward: Safely rescue Chen Nian, preserve strength

text.content: After pondering briefly, Chen Ji chose the more conservative plan. He turned to Ye Qing: "I'll break the formation eye first. You provide support from the perimeter. If things turn bad, we retreat immediately." Ye Qing nodded. The Demon Path mist had already quietly spread outward, thoroughly concealing their aura. Chen Ji took a deep breath. The power of the Tianji Record began gathering in his palm, but he deliberately restrained its quantity.

The golden light of the Tianji Record collided violently with the barrier formation runes, emitting a deafening roar. The four stone pillars in the cell cracked simultaneously. The layers of light screens shattered like glass. The formation eye beneath Chen Nian's feet collapsed with a thunderous boom. At the same time, a muffled explosion came from Ye Qing's side—the formation runes on the altar were eroded by the Demon Path mist, and the chanting stopped abruptly. Both formation cores failed simultaneously. Chen Nian stared in astonishment at the scene before her, unable to believe it was real. "Brother Ji..." Her voice trembled. "You really came to save me." Chen Ji walked forward, personally unlocking her chains. His gaze was gentle yet carried a cold undertone: "Let's go. Home."
